issues.description: Duplicate React imports: `useState` and `useEffect` are imported twice from 'react' - once on line 2 and again on line 4. This causes a compile error and prevents the page from loading.
issues.root_cause: Line 2 `import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';` was accidentally left in when a more complete import statement on line 4 `import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';` already covers those hooks. Both imports define the same identifiers which is forbidden by the SWC compiler.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate partial import on line 2. The complete import on line 4 already includes useState and useEffect along with useCallback and useRef, so the first import is redundant and causes the compile error.
